name: Illinois

filing.name: Illinois Secretary of State, Business Services

llcReport.title: File Annual Report
llcReport.deadline: Before the first day of the anniversary month

penalty.note: When filed more than 60 days after the due date

corpReport.title: File Annual Report
corpReport.deadline: Before the first day of the anniversary month

penalty.note: Late annual report penalty is 10% of Illinois franchise tax; late franchise tax also accrues 2% per month, minimum $1. No penalty or interest is computed when no franchise tax is due.

lpReport.deadline: Before the first day of the anniversary month

penalty.note: When filed more than 60 days after the due date

llpReport.title: File LLP renewal statement
llpReport.deadline: Within the 60 days before the registration expires; registration lasts one year

penalty.note: When filed more than 60 days after the due date

entityTax: Corporate income tax; Personal Property Replacement Tax on partnerships and S corporations

salesTax.permit: Illinois Certificate of Registration (Retailers' Occupation Tax)

permitFee.note: Illinois charges no registration fee for a sales and use tax Certificate of Registration.

penalty.note: 2% of the tax for a payment 1 to 30 days late and 10% after that; the late-filing penalty is the lesser of $250 or 2% of the tax due.

unemployment.note: No current official penalty amount for a late wage report was found in the state agency's published sources.

newHire.note: $15 for each new hire the employer knowingly fails to report.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Civil penalty of up to $500 per day of noncompliance for a knowing and willful failure to obtain coverage (820 ILCS 305/4).

local.title: Municipal business license
local.description: Chicago and many municipalities require business licenses (Chicago: BACP).

industry.realEstate: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
industry.childCare: Illinois Department of Children and Family Services

cannabis.regulator: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation and Department of Agriculture
